ratio_auto.title: Automatic Ratio Calculation
ratio_auto.desc: Ratios are calculated from Qiniu official prices (CNY per 1M tokens) synced to the marketplace: model ratio = input price / 14, completion ratio = output price / input price. Free models and locked models are skipped. It also runs in the background after channel saves and daily price syncs.
